projection_policy: No scientific program, model, optimizer, inference or DFT was executed to assemble this bundle.
Source paths replaced by run-relative artifact identifiers; container IDs, private paths, GPU UUIDs, telemetry and scheduler records omitted.
Summary JSON is a whitelist projection of completed records. Scientific floats are serialized without rounding.
CSV curves and step340 force CSVs are byte-exact copies; static forces and DFT4fs curves are column projections of completed records.
Selected XYZ snapshots serialize existing positions and forces; no geometry reconstruction, relaxation or force recomputation.
Input path substitutions and stale comment removal are listed per file. The original LAMMPS stop-control bug is retained.
Figures are redrawn only from bundled compact numerical tables; no smoothing, interpolation or missing-frame filling.
